MINUTES
  REGULAR PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION
  JANUARY 17, 2017

A regular meeting of the Park and Activities Commission of the City of Rolling Hills Estates
was called to order at 7:00 p.m. in the City Hall Council Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes
Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California, by CHAIR PORTUGAL.

COMMISSIONERS PRESENT: Giglia, Persichina, Pope, Chairman Portugal, Retz, and
  Romanelli

STAFF PRESENT:  Andy Clark, Community Services Director

PARK AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES, DECEMBER 19, 2016

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ

  TO APPROVE THE DRAFT MEETING MINUTES OF DECEMBER 19, 2016, AS
  WRITTEN.

THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL SO ORDERED.

AUDIENCE ITEMS/WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON THE AGENDA

None.

CONSENT CALENDAR

A.  STREET TREE REMOVAL APPLICATION

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  APPROVE THE CONSENT CALENDAR

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL SO ORDERED.

BUSINESS ITEMS

A.  PROPOSED NEW LITTLE FREE LIBRARY SITES

  Community Services Director Clark provided an overview of a request from an
  Eagle Scout to install Little Free Library units at Ernie Howlett Park and Dapplegray
  Park.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI stated that he would like the new Little Libraries to
  be as nice or nicer as the existing Little Libraries. Community Services Director
  Clark stated that the same troop who built the existing units will be building the new
  units.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  APPROVE THE INSTALLATION OF (2) FREE LITTLE LIBRARY UNITS
  CONSTRUCTED AS AN EAGLE SCOUT PROJECT AT ERNIE HOWLETT
  AND DAPPLEGRAY PARKS AS PROPOSED

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL SO ORDERED.

B.  STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION PROJECT PROPOSAL

  Community Services Director Clark provided an overview of the request from the
  Rollingwood Homeowners Association (HOA) for approval of $725 in matching
  funds from the City’s street entryway program. The Rollingwood HOA is proposing
  to replace sections of 3-rail wood fencing to vinyl fencing in their street entryway.

Regular Park & Activities Commission Meeting
January 17, 2017  1
   CHAIR PORTUGAL asked about the requirement for bids. Community Services
  Director Clark stated that the contractor, Priority One Fencing, is the City’s fence
  contractor.

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI stated that Priority One has done a good job in his
  neighborhood and advised the applicant to make an effort to have the contractor
  commit to a schedule.

  COMMISSIONER POPE recused herself.

  COMMISSIONER RETZ moved, seconded by CHAIR PORTUGAL to,

  THE PROPOSAL FOR THE STREET ENTRYWAY BEAUTIFICATION
  PROJECT AS PROPOSED

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL SO ORDERED.

  AYES:  Giglia, Persichina, Chair Portugal, Retz, and Romanelli
  NOES:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
  RECUSE:  Pope
  ABSENT:  None

C.  PVP LAND CONSERVANCY RECOGNITION PLAQUE REQUEST

  Community Services Director Clark provided an overview of the request from the
  Palos Verdes Peninsula (PVP) Land Conservancy to install a plaque on a boulder
  near the end of the Stein-Hale Nature Trail in recognition of its supporters, who
  expanded the open space in this canyon.

  In a response to a question from COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI, Community
  Services Director Clark stated that staff concluded that this item qualifies as an
  event, as one of the requirements in the City’s policy, and that it also contributes to
  the City’s goal to create and conserve open space for the residents.

  In response to a question from COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI, Community
  Services Director Clark stated that the Palos Verdes Peninsula Land Conservancy
  will pay for the plaque.

  COMMISSIONER PERSICHINA asked that the type of structure that a plaque can
  be attached to be reviewed.

  Andrea Vona, PVP Land Conservancy, stated that she went through the
  acknowledgments in the City’s policy and provided affirmative responses to those
  criteria.

  CHAIR PORTUGAL moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER POPE to,

  MAKE A RECOMMENDATION FOR CITY COUNCIL TO APPROVE THE
  PVP LAND CONSERVANCY RECOGNITION PLAQUE APPLICATION ON
  THE STEIN-HAL TRAIL IN THE GORGE F. CANYON NATURE PRESERVE.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL SO ORDERED.

D.  SILVER SPUR LITTLE LEAGUE IMPROVEMENTS REQUEST

  Community Services Director Clark provided an overview of a request from the
  Silver Spur Little League to make improvements to the concrete pad adjacent to the
  food concession structure in Ernie Howlett Park. In addition, staff recommends that
  a condition be added to remove and replace the existing SMALL concrete pad.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA asked about ADA requirements since there is no ramp
  to the structure. Community Services Director Clark responded that yes, ADA
  compliance should be a condition of approval.

Regular Park & Activities Commission Meeting
January 17, 2017  2
   COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked if plans can be reviewed. Community
  Service Director Clark stated that they would be provided at the next meeting.

  COMMISSIONER RETZ recommended that a Civil Engineer should review the
  plans since there is expansive soil more rebar or thicker concrete may be needed
  for it to last. Community Services Director Clark agreed.

  COMMISSIONER GIGLIA moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI to,

  APPROVE THE SILVER SPUR LITTLE LEAGUE’S REQUEST TO EXPAND
  THE CONCRETE PAD TO THE ORGANIZATION’S FOOD CONCESSION
  STRUCTURE IN ERNIE HOWLETT PARK WITH THE FOLLOWING
  CONDITIONS: 1) DETERMINE SUFFICIENT AMOUNT OF REBAR IS
  USED; 2) HAVE THE SLAB SLOPE TOWARD THE CANYON; 3) PROVIDE
  A BRUSH FINISH; 4) MAKE ACCESSIBILITY TO THE SNACK SHACK ADA
  COMPLIANT; 5) CONSTRUCT THE PAD UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF
  THE CITY’S MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR; 6) HAVE CONCRETE PLANS
  REVIEWED BY A CIVIL ENGINEER; AND 7) HAVE FINAL PLANS
  REVIEWED BY THE PARKS AND ACTIVITIES COMMISSION.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL SO ORDERED.

COMMISSION ITEMS (Verbal Report)

A.  ADOPT-A-PARK

  CHAIR PORTUGAL stated that at George F. Canyon Nature Center, the wooden
  overlook that had fallen had yellow “Caution” tape and the tape has come down. The
  overlook is open. Community Services Director Clark stated that this will be taken
  care of right away.

  CHAIR PORTUGAL stated that the doggie bags need to be replenished and the
  water fountain is not working. Community Services Director Clark stated that he will
  forward this information to the Maintenance Supervisor.

  COMMISSIONER RETZ stated that the fencing at Dapplegray Park may need some
  repainting and some fence posts were dislodged by the rain and need repair.
  Community Services Director Clark stated that staff is waiting for a 3rd quote for paint.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL RECEIVED AND FILED THE
  ADOPT-A-PARK REPORT.

B.  60TH ANNIVERSARY SUBCOMMITTEE UPDATE

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI stated that at the 60th Anniversary Subcommittee
  meeting, members agreed that there will be no new City events added and that the
  annually planned events will promote the City’s 60th City Celebration. The banner
  that was made for the 50th Anniversary will be used with a change to reflect the 60th
  Anniversary.

  COMMISSIONER POPE asked about a marketing plan to roll out the 60 th
  Anniversary with the planned events. Community Services Director Clark stated that
  yes, staff will work on doing this. COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI added that the
  committee will provide guidance as well.

DIRECTOR’S ITEMS (Verbal Report)

A.  NEW SOCIAL MEDIA POLICY

  Community Services Director Clark stated that Alexa Davis, Assistant to the City
  Manager provided information on the City’s new Social Media Policy.

B.  SOUTH BAY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS GENERAL ASSEMBY
  REGISTRATION, FEBRUARY 24, 2017

Regular Park & Activities Commission Meeting
January 17, 2017  3
   Community Services Director Clark announced the South Bay Council of
  Governments General Assembly and that Parks & Activities Commissioners who are
  interested in attending should register by February 24th.

C.  PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH MODEL MEDIAN LANDSCAPING PROJECT

  Community Services Director Clark stated that the model median was finished
  today, January 17, 2017 and are awaiting feedback from the community.

MATTERS OF INFORMATION

A.  CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF DECEMBER 13, 2016

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE THE CITY COUNCIL ACTIONS OF DECEMBER 13,
  2016.

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL SO ORDERED.

B.  PLANNING COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES OF JANUARY 9, 2017

  COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI moved, seconded by COMMISSIONER RETZ to,

  RECEIVE AND FILE THE PLANNING COMMISSION DRAFT MINUTES OF
  JANUARY 9, 2017

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL SO ORDERED.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

Community Services Director Clark stated that he would soon set-up a meeting with the
City Celebration Subcommittee to review the suggestions that came from the debriefing
meeting.

Community Services Director stated that there is a City Council Policy Development
Session on March 4 at 8:00 a.m.

COMMISSIONER ROMANELLI asked for an update on the new playground equipment.
Community Services Director Clark stated that it was order in mid-December and should
be ready by the end of February.

ADJOURNMENT

  THERE BEING NO OBJECTION, CHAIR PORTUGAL ADJOURNED THE MEETING
  AT 7:32 P.M.

Respectfully submitted,  Approved,

_______________________  ______________________
Carol Corea  Douglas R. Prichard
Minutes Secretary  City Clerk
